key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch. When off, no engine process is spawned and the static GNOME wallpaper is shown.

key.name: engine
key.description: Which backend renders the wallpaper. "auto" picks linux-wallpaperengine when a Workshop scene is configured and the binary is installed, otherwise mpv.

key.name: video-path
key.description: Absolute path to a local MP4, WebM, MKV or GIF file used by the mpv backend.

key.name: wallpaper-id
key.description: Steam Workshop item ID (e.g. 1845706469) or an absolute path to a scene directory / .pkg file, used by the linux-wallpaperengine backend.

key.name: workshop-path
key.description: Directory containing downloaded Wallpaper Engine Workshop items (one numeric folder per item).

key.name: assets-path
key.description: Optional path to the "assets" folder shipped with the Windows Wallpaper Engine installation. Leave empty to let linux-wallpaperengine auto-detect it from the Steam library.

key.name: wallpaperengine-path
key.description: Command name or absolute path of the linux-wallpaperengine executable.

key.name: mpv-path
key.description: Command name or absolute path of the mpv executable.

key.name: mute
key.description: Silence all wallpaper audio regardless of the volume setting.

key.name: volume
key.description: Wallpaper audio volume in percent, used when not muted.

key.name: fps
key.description: Maximum frames per second the wallpaper is rendered at. Lower values save GPU/CPU and battery.

key.name: monitor-index
key.description: Index of the monitor the wallpaper is rendered on. -1 means the primary monitor.

key.name: scaling
key.description: How the wallpaper is fitted to the monitor: "fit" letterboxes preserving aspect ratio, "fill" crops preserving aspect ratio, "stretch" ignores aspect ratio.
